guide.title: Start with one week
guide.guidance: Set Start date and available Capacity in Weekly Review. Filter Master Plan by Start week, then Category and Scope. Complete the setup and baseline first.

guide.title: Record progress once
guide.guidance: Update task Status, Actual hours, Evidence and Completed on. The Completion check explains missing proof. For mocks, also enter both scores and the result.

guide.title: Task completion versus readiness
guide.guidance: Complete means a task has been marked Done with recorded evidence and date. A mock may be complete even if it failed. This is not a prediction of interview success.

guide.title: Work categories and sections
guide.guidance: Category groups the work. Work type distinguishes learning, builds, practice, mocks and reviews. Plan section gives the more specific topic. Scope separates core work and optional extensions.

guide.title: Practice without double counting
guide.guidance: DSA counts are distinct solved problems by pattern. Question counts are attempts. Put problem IDs or answer evidence in the evidence field and capture mistakes for revision.

guide.title: Dates and review
guide.guidance: Start/end week are relative to your chosen start date. Due date is the end of the task’s end week. Review due is completion/practice date plus the review interval. Original phase-review notes are retained.

guide.title: Estimates and actual time
guide.guidance: The proposed task estimates are starting allocations, not guarantees for learning a skill. Actual hours stay at the source zero baseline. Change estimates after assessment; avoid logging the same time against a lesson and a project.

guide.title: Extend the plan
guide.guidance: Add a row within the relevant Excel Table and use a unique ID. Copy the calculated columns from an adjacent row. Summary formulas use the table columns and include added records. Keep the week between 1 and 24 or extend the weekly schedule too.

guide.title: Confidence
guide.guidance: Original 0-5 self-ratings are retained. 0 means not yet demonstrated; 5 means independently solve and explain under interview pressure. Confidence does not drive task completion.

guide.title: One capstone with reusable evidence
guide.guidance: Use a single Java/Spring backend and TypeScript UI product. Project ONE is recorded as existing exposure, not verified completion. Extension profiles can document the same capstone rather than create separate compulsory projects.

guide.title: Original workbook
guide.guidance: Fresher_SWE_Interview_Command_Center.xlsx is preserved separately. All 436 substantive curriculum, schedule, question, mock, strategy and project rows have a mapped destination. Duplicate dashboards and forecast-weighted confidence calculations are replaced.

guide.title: Source interpretation
guide.guidance: Source IDs point to references below. Checked references show the check date. Inherited market notes are retained as context and have not all been reverified; do not treat them as 2027 hiring guarantees.

guide.title: Live category views
guide.guidance: Edit Master Plan only. Existing category tabs show matching tasks in master order, including changes to category, status, dates, evidence and effort. Use Task ID to find the matching master row.

guide.title: Adding tasks
guide.guidance: Insert a table row within PlanTasks or press Tab from its last cell. Excel must extend the table and its calculated columns, including Category key. Use an existing Category value. Category tabs reserve 300 task rows each; copy the final formula row downward if needed.

guide.title: Dashboard interpretation
guide.guidance: Category and section totals include Core and Optional tasks. The headline completion percentage uses Core only. Complete requires evidence and completion date; mocks additionally require scores and a result. Progress does not establish interview readiness.

guide.title: New categories and sections
guide.guidance: Existing category membership updates automatically. A brand-new category needs a new category tab and dashboard label. New section labels need a dashboard row with copied formulas. Coverage counts on Dashboard flag unlisted labels.
